baseline_models.focus_anchor: The feminine plural active participle at word 1 and its cognate accusative at word 2 present release as an emphatic performed action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tension applied to a loop or restraint makes it come apart and sends what was held free.

activation_trace.role: A loop loosened by pulling supplies the concrete release mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Unspecified agents emphatically perform an act of nasht.
changed_reading.after: The agents pull a fastening to the point of release, foregrounding controlled unbinding rather than generic motion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated root in the participle and cognate accusative intensifies the manner of the action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Inner readiness and strength become outward, willing movement or work.

activation_trace.role: Readiness and good spirit for movement supply energetic agency as the verse's manner.

changed_reading.before: The agents merely move or act.
changed_reading.after: The agents spring into action with willing vigor, and the cognate accusative marks the action as fully energized.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active participial form can name agents characterized by the root's movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: A mover leaves one location or condition and crosses into another.

activation_trace.role: Departure and transfer from place to place supply a threshold-crossing motion.

changed_reading.before: The line denotes motion without a specified spatial relation.
changed_reading.after: The line depicts agents setting out from one domain and transferring into another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both focus words carry one root whose inventory includes removal from a covering and a quick drawing action.
baseline_models.mechanism: A swift pull separates an embedded or covered thing from what encloses it; peeling supplies the boundary-crossing geometry.

activation_trace.role: Peeling something out of its skin supplies removal across an enclosing boundary.
A quick unaided draw supplies speed and tensile force to the extraction.

changed_reading.before: The action is an unspecified release.
changed_reading.after: The agents swiftly draw something out through the boundary that held or covered it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root has a branch for a route or watercourse that leaves a main course.
baseline_models.mechanism: Movement is produced by divergence: a course peels away from a dominant path and opens a lateral route.

activation_trace.role: A side road or branching watercourse supplies divergence as the focus action.

changed_reading.before: The plural describes mobile agents on an undifferentiated route.
changed_reading.after: The plural can describe agents or courses that branch decisively away from a main line.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding clause supplies exhaustive dislodgement, while the focus supplies release by loosening; together they form either two contrasted extraction modes or a force-then-disentangle sequence.

activation_trace.role: A pulled loop coming loose makes the focus operation controlled disentanglement.
Uprooting from a settled place supplies the forceful neighboring operation.
Comprehensive engulfing or completion makes the neighboring removal exhaustive.

structural_cues: 79:1 and 79:2 are adjacent oath clauses with matched feminine plural participles and cognate accusatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: matched clauses pair exhaustive uprooting with pull-release. Reader arrow: the first action places a held thing under force and the second frees its remaining entanglement. Live alternatives: the clauses may name separate agents or near-synonymous modes rather than successive phases.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a self-contained act of untying.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the controlled disengagement that contrasts with, or completes, an exhaustive uprooting.

context_deltas.mechanism: Release from restraint becomes the launch stage of an ordered kinetic chain: free movement, overtaking, and then outcome-aware administration of an affair.

activation_trace.role: Release after restraint supplies the chain's enabling first transition.
Setting out from one place supplies directed departure after release.
Running or swimming supplies sustained free traversal after the launch.
Advancing and racing supply the chain's acceleration into precedence.
Planning with regard to consequences turns prior motion into ordered administration.
An affair or state supplies the object brought under administration.

structural_cues: The opening series advances from coordinated oath clauses to fa-linked precedence and administration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: release/departure is followed by traversal, precedence, and administration. Reader arrow: each operation enables the next, so the focus is a launch gate. Live alternative: the list may coordinate independent classes whose actions are not causal stages.

changed_reading.before: Departure in the focus is an isolated transfer.
changed_reading.after: The focus is a release-and-launch operation that enables rapid traversal, precedence, and ordered effect.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's quick drawing action becomes a model for crossing out of decayed enclosure into a restored condition, with one driving impulse collapsing a seemingly difficult return into immediacy.

activation_trace.role: A rapid draw from depth supplies the transition's extraction mechanics and speed.
Return to a former place supplies the destination of the extraction.
Return to an initial condition sharpens restoration rather than mere relocation.
Decay supplies the resistant enclosure or state from which return seems impossible.
Recurrence after an interval supplies the temporal shape of return.
A forceful vocal drive supplies the initiating impulse for the rapid transition.
Numerical singleness compresses the mechanism into one initiating event.

structural_cues: 79:10-14 moves from an objection about return and decay to one driving event and immediate presence on an exposed surface.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: return, prior condition, decay, recurrence, and one drive occur in sequence. Reader arrow: the focus's quick pull is an operative analogy for that transition. Live alternative: the opening action may only precede this scene rhetorically and need not execute its return.

changed_reading.before: The quick pull removes an unspecified object from an unspecified depth.
changed_reading.after: The quick pull evokes abrupt release from decay into a restored state, making return a single-transition event.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knot-release acquires a social and volitional analogue: an invitation offers self-disengagement from limit-breaking attachment, while refusal and disobedience culminate in compulsory seizure.

activation_trace.role: Loosening a restraint supplies the focus anchor for voluntary disengagement.
Exceeding a limit in disobedience supplies the attachment from which disengagement is needed.
Purification and right ordering supply the offered self-directed change.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies a non-coercive route out.
Departure from obedience blocks the offered voluntary transition.
Seizure and capture supply the compulsory counterpart to self-release.

structural_cues: The Moses-Pharaoh narrative orders invitation, refusal, disobedience, and seizure as successive alternatives and consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: purification and gentle guidance are offered to a limit-breaker who refuses and is seized. Reader arrow: purification is treated as loosening oneself from an attachment, contrasted with later forced detachment. Live alternative: the narrative may exemplify judgment without specifying the opening agents or their action.

changed_reading.before: Release is only a physical operation on a restraint.
changed_reading.after: Release also models the offered possibility of self-disengagement before refusal converts separation into compulsory seizure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The side-course branch of the focus becomes hydraulic: branching channels provide paths by which hidden water emerges and sustains pasture, while anchored masses supply the stable counterforce.

activation_trace.role: A route or watercourse leaving the main line supplies the focus's branching geometry.
A valley as a torrent path supplies a concrete channel at surah scale.
Bringing a hidden thing outward supplies the channel's release function.
Water appearing and increasing supplies what the branching paths convey.
Pasture supplied by grazing growth gives the released flow an ecological effect.
Fixity and anchoring supply the stable contrast that shapes the moving channels.

structural_cues: A valley appears in the narrative band, while the creation band juxtaposes emerging water and pasture with anchored mountains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the focus inventory includes branching runnels, and the surah supplies valley, emerging water, pasture, and anchoring. Reader arrow: the plural focus agents are allowed to be flow paths rather than animate beings. Live alternative: these remote material cues may be analogies only, with the oath agents remaining animate movers.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes agents veering from a main route.
changed_reading.after: The focus can picture branching release channels whose movement distributes water through an otherwise stabilized landscape.

context_deltas.mechanism: Vigor is no longer morally self-interpreting: energetic movement becomes accountable striving when preference gives it a direction, while restraint can interrupt the self's inclination.

activation_trace.role: Readiness and vigorous movement supply morally unspecified motive force.
Work, earning, and action turn motive force into remembered human conduct.
Preference by choice supplies the vector assigned to energetic striving.
Restraint and checking supply a brake capable of redirecting activation.
The self's force and disposition supply the interior site of activation.
Inclination of the self supplies one possible direction for energetic movement.

structural_cues: The judgment band remembers what a human strove for, then contrasts chosen preference with restraint of inclination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: vigorous activation, accountable striving, preference, self-force, inclination, and restraint coexist. Reader arrow: the opening physical energy is used as an analogue for motive energy whose value depends on direction. Live alternative: the later psychology may govern human response without redescribing the opening subjects.

changed_reading.before: The focus praises or depicts sheer vigorous motion.
changed_reading.after: The focus exposes motive force before moral sorting: energy becomes accountable through what it pursues and whether inclination is checked.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the context surface is a question-form root while the activating image comes from its packet-supplied non-dominant mapped root. It remains valid as an activation because gentle hidden drawing and slipping directly meet the focus's pull-release branches. Downstream prose should label it a split-root lexical resonance, not an etymological equation or an identification of the oath agents.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventory combines loop-release with a quick drawing action, permitting the manner of extraction to be respecified.

activation_trace.role: Release under tension supplies the operation that the outlier makes covert and gentle.
Quick drawing supplies the extraction side of the focus.
Gentle hidden drawing changes the imagined manner from conspicuous force to covert extraction.
Slipping out supplies a low-friction completion of the release.

changed_reading.before: The focus's quick pull is overtly forceful.
changed_reading.after: The focus may also evoke something drawn free by a swift, almost hidden slipping motion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it takes a specialized focus branch about descending after prolonged riding and connects it to remote endpoint language. It remains anchored in an explicit focus branch and in the closing sequence's anchoring, terminus, and curtailed dwelling. Downstream prose should present it as a journey-shaped analogy, not as a settled identity for the plural subjects.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A specialized focus branch names descent from a mount after a long ride, turning the action into arrival and disengagement from transport.

activation_trace.role: Dismounting after prolonged riding supplies a journey-ending form of release.
Anchoring and coming to rest supply the journey's arrival condition.
A terminal limit supplies the destination at which dismounting becomes apt.
Dwelling supplies the elapsed stay retrospectively compressed at arrival.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts extraction during motion.
changed_reading.after: The focus can picture travelers disengaging from their conveyance at a final anchorage after what seemed a long passage.

strongest_changes: Immediate pairing with exhaustive uprooting changed loop-release into a controlled contrasting or second-phase extraction.
The opening motion series changed departure into a launch gate that enables traversal, precedence, and administration.
The return sequence made the quick-pull branch a mechanism for abrupt passage out of decay into restored condition.
The judgment band revised vigor into motive force whose significance depends on preference and restraint.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation let one compact root construction sustain distinct mechanical, kinetic, temporal, ecological, social, and volitional models without forcing them into one referent.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle the identity of the feminine plural subjects.
The opening clauses may coordinate different agents rather than stages of one causal chain.
The hydraulic, split-root, and dismount readings are branch-anchored but remain cross-domain exploratory activations.
